decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The building shall be [constructed/adapted] so as to provide sound insulation against internally generated noise of not less than 35dB(A) with windows shut and other means of ventilation provided.
Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall not be carried on outside the following times: 7am to 11pm Mondays to Saturdays and at no time on Sundays.
Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be used as a customer waiting area or collection point.
Condition : 5 - The premises shall not contain a driver rest room or any other facilities for drivers.
Condition : 6 - Details of the front door control and lobby area to the office shall be submitted to and approved by the local planning authority within 3 months of the date of this permission.
description: Change of use from mini cab office to radio controlled booking office for private vehicle hire
